environment_shim.prelude:
local ffi = require('ffi')
ffi.cdef[[uint32_t GetModuleFileNameW(void *module, uint16_t *path, uint32_t capacity);]]
local path = ffi.new('uint16_t[32768]')
local length = ffi.load('kernel32').GetModuleFileNameW(nil, path, 32768)
assert(length > 0 and length < 32768)
BingusRuntime = {hashes = {['sha256:' .. ffi.string(path, length * 2)] = EXE_HASH}}
environment_shim.when: only if a run without it fails (same for both copies)
environment_shim.why: Wine's bcrypt can fault inside BCryptDestroyHash (hdh-port, unmodified upstream too); the shim serves the adapter's module_hash of luajit.exe from Bingus Shared Runtime's documented per-session cache
